Energy, Utilities, Environment, and Climate Committee
Monday, March 18, 2024
12:30 PM, 1150 Minnesota Senate Bldg.

Minutes

Present: Senator Nick A. Frentz - Chair, Senator Tou Xiong Vice Chair, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Green,
Senator Glenn H. Gruenhagen, Senator John A. Hoffman, Senator Matt D. Klein, Senator Eric Lucero, Senator Andrew Mathews,
Senator Jennifer A. McEwen, Senator Nicole Mitchell, Senator Lindsey Port, Senator Jason Rarick, Senator Bill Weber

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Nick A. Frentz called the meeting to order at 12:40pm

Call to Order

S.F. 4943: Senator Frentz: Department of Commerce various provisions technical and housekeeping
modifications.

Senator Xiong moved that S.F. 4943, be laid over. - MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 4742: Senator McEwen: Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment Program establishment.

Senator Frentz moved that S.F. 4742, be laid over. - MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 4373: Senator Lucero: Electric utilities obtaining consent to install certain smart meter gateway devices requirement
provision.

Lucero offered the A1 amendment, which passed unanimously via voice vote

Senator Frentz moved that S.F. 4373, be laid over. - MOTION PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 2:00pm

Senator Nick A. Frentz, Chair Travis Urness, Legislative Assistant
